title: Essential attributes: Wujud, Qidam and Baqa
intro: Allah exists, has always been, and will be forever.

learn.text: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith] And in yourselves. Then will you not see?

learn.html: In the Qur’an, Allah (SWT) revealed ayat about Himself so that people can know Him and believe in Him. His attributes belong only to Him and speak of His exalted Being and His perfection. People may describe Allah only the way He described Himself in His Book, and may never compare any creation with Him.

Allah’s attributes are divided into as-sifat adh-dhatiyyah – the attributes of His being – and as-sifat ath-thubutiyyah – the attributes of His perfection. Wujud, Qidam and Baqa belong to the first group.

learn.title: Wujud – Allah exists
learn.html: Allah is unseen to us, but He has given us proofs of His existence. His existence is beyond doubt, because our creation and existence come from His. In this passing world nothing came about by itself – everything has a cause, and Allah (SWT) is the cause of all causes. We exist, so we believe that Allah exists.

learn.title: Qidam – Allah has always been
learn.html: Allah’s existence has no beginning and was never brought about. He is the First, because He never came into being.

learn.title: Baqa – Allah is forever
learn.html: Because Allah has no beginning, He has no end either. Eternity belongs to Him, without beginning and without end: what never came into being will never end.
No human mind can fully understand “always” and “forever” – that is why it is our duty to believe in them firmly.

learn.title: ⭐ Talk with your mu‘allim
learn.html: Eternity belongs to Allah (SWT); everything He created passes away.
